# hoop_agent (Resource)

Manage an agent resource in Hoop Platform. The generated token is returned only when the agent is created and is stored as sensitive Terraform state. Imported agents cannot recover an existing token because the Hoop API never returns agent secrets after creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hoop_agent" "example" {
  name = "terraform-agent"
  mode = "standard"
}

resource "hoop_connection" "example" {
  name     = "terraform-agent-bash"
  type     = "custom"
  agent_id = hoop_agent.example.id

  command = ["/bin/bash"]

  access_mode_runbooks = "enabled"
  access_mode_exec     = "enabled"
  access_mode_connect  = "disabled"
  access_schema        = "disabled"
}

output "hoop_agent_token" {
  value     = hoop_agent.example.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the agent resource.

### Optional

- `mode` (String) The agent operation mode. Valid values are `standard` or `embedded`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the agent resource.
- `status` (String) The current agent connection status reported by Hoop.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The generated agent token in DSN form. Hoop only returns this value at creation time, so Terraform preserves it in sensitive state for downstream resources. This value is unavailable for imported agents.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import hoop_agent.example <agent-id>
```
